Expenditure on education
†*241. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the
proposed draft of the Eleventh Five Year
Plan Rs. 2.85 lakh crore have been allocated
for expenditure on education;
(b) if not, the exact amount thereof;
(c) how much of this allocated amount
has been actually spent on education during
April to September of 2007-08, the first
year of the Plan period; and
(d) the percentage of total allocation of
Rs. 2.85 lakh crore, which was allocated
for expenditure during the whole of this
year?
77
Collection of electricity dues in rural
areas
†*242. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of POWERbe pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has formulated a scheme to charge the bill-
amount for electricity consumption from
the rural consumers in the country by
paying commission to non-Government
institutions to charge the same;
(b) if so, the details of the said scheme;
(c) whether this scheme is already in
force in certain States, if so, the names of
such States; and
(d) what are the likely benefits of
implementing this scheme?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Land for Kendriya Vidyalayas
*243. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of Kendriya Vidyalayas
that need land to be allotted;
(b) steps taken to secure land for such
KVs; and
(c) whether it is a fact that a
Parliamentary Committee has expressed
reservation over the efforts made by the
Ministry in this regard?
Increase in number of Old
Age Homes
*244. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA: Will the Minister of SOCIAL
JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has any
proposal/scheme to increase the number of
Old Age Homes in different parts of the
country, specially in Karnataka;
(b) if so, the details of funds sanctioned
for the same and by when the scheme is
going to be implemented; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Performance of Sarva Shiksha
Abhiyan
†*245. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is satisfied
with the performance of Sarva Shiksha
Abhiyan;
(b) whether Government is aware of
the poor allocation for this Scheme; and
(c) if so, the steps taken in this regard?
Information Technology and
Engineering Colleges
*246. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is
contemplating to set up Information
Technology and Engineering Colleges in
Sikkim;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of such colleges
proposed to be set up in the State during
2007-08; and
(d) the details of steps taken by
Government, so far, in this regard?
Production of equipments for
renewable energy generation
*247. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE:
Will the Minister of NEW AND
RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is planning
dedicated SEZs for the production of
equipments involved in the renewable
energy generation sector, aiming at giving a
fillip to renewable energy generation besides
developing India as a manufacturing and
research hub for equipments used in the
setting up of green power facilities in the
country and abroad;
(b) whether Government has decided
to set up SEZs for the renewable energy
sector, to be constructed purely on a
private-public partnership model;

79
(c) whether five States have already
shown interest in this regard; and
(d) by when a final decision in this
regard is likely to be taken?
Specific programme to check dropouts
*248. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
there has been an increase in the number of
dropouts from elementary school during
the current year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether there is any specific
programme planned by Government to
reduce the number during the current Plan
period; and
(d) if so, the details of the programme
and the ratio of Central allocation for this
programme, State-wise?

the entry of foreign universities to offer

Total number of questions — 155
Opening of Weather Channel
†1320. SHRIMATI. SUSHMA
SWARAJ: Will the Minister of EARTH
SCIENCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is considering to start a 24 hours Weather
Channel;
(b) if so, by when it would be started;
and
(c) whether networking of all the
weather offices of the country would be
done for this channel; if so, the details in
this regard?
Food processing units in Karnataka
1321. SHRI RAJEEV
CHANDRASEKHAR: Will the Minister of
FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be
pleased to state:
(a) the number and details of cases for
opening new units for food processing in
Karnataka which are pending for clearance
with Government; and
(b) by when each of them is likely to be
cleared?
Funds for cold storage facilities
1322. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the funds allocated for setting up
cold storage facilities at various places
alongwith the funds utilized, State-wise,
during the last three years;
(b) what has been the demand for such
facilities and how much supply has been
met; and
(c) whether there would be a policy
initiative and time-frame, on priority, to
complete these facilities in total?
Food processing units in Punjab
1323. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the requests for starting
food processing units in Punjab are
pending with Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof in each case;
and

(c) by when the decision on the requests
is likely to be taken?
Setting up of National Institute of Food
Technology
1324. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to set up a
National Institute of Food Technology, to
address the growing manpower needs in
the food processing industry;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action plan of Government to
promote food-processing sector in the
backward States like Bihar, Orissa,
Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, etc., to improve
their rural economy?
Action plan for enhancing capacity of
cold storages
†1325. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has prepared
or propose to prepare any action plan, to
enhance the capacity of existing cold
storages in the country, in order to increase
the sources of income in rural areas;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the funds allocated during the
current financial year for this purpose?
Food processing industries
1326. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
SHRI N.R.
GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) the total number of food processing
industries in the country during the last
three years, State-wise and year-wise;
(b) whether Government has sanctioned
some new projects during the current
financial year;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) the number of project applications
received/sanctioned/rejected and pending
during the last three years, State-wise; and
(e) the financial assistance released for
there projects to the States under
Government's Plan Schemes?
Assistance to voluntary organisations
under SSA
†1327. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) how many voluntary organisations
were provided assistance under Sarva
Shiksha Abhiyan by the Ministry during
the last three years; and
(b) the details and number of blocks and
villages in Rajasthan where this Abhiyan
is being conducted?
Voluntary organisations
†1328. SHRI BANWARI LAL
KANCHHAL: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the amount allocated under the public

(b) the number of voluntary

(d) if so, the number of such voluntary
